newsitem.title: UK: Barclays shares rise as seminar starts.
newsitem.headline: Barclays shares rise as seminar starts.

text.p: Shares in British bank Barclays Plc touched a new year's high on Thursday amid what dealers called a string of steady, small-scale orders as a seminar for institutional investors and analysts started in London.

Barclays shares rose to 984p before settling back to 982p, up 6-1/2p at 1120 GMT. Some 655,000 shares had changed hands. "Basically we've seen a few small buy orders but nothing spectacular," one marketmaker said.
Dealers said there had so far been no news from a seminar hosted by Barclays for institutional investors and analysts at its head office in London on Thursday morning.
"We might see some movement once that starts trickling through but for now, it's reasonably quiet," a dealer said.
